learning_outcomes.text: Students will be able to define heat transfer by conduction.
Students will be able to define heat transfer by convection.
Students will be able to define heat transfer by radiation.
Students will be able to analyze heat transfer problems in chemical engineering.
Students will be able to design a heat exchanger.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of Heat Transfer/Heat Transfer Mechanisms: Conduction, Convection, Radiation
Heat Conduction Equation, Steady-State Heat Conduction
Heat Conduction in Plane, Cylindrical and Spherical Surfaces
Critical Radius of Insulation, Heat Transfer from Finned Surfaces, Heat Transfer for Various Configurations
Fundamentals of Convection, Analogies between Momentum, Heat and Mass Transfer
bibliography: Çengel, Yunus A., “Introduction to Thermodynamics and Heat Transfer”, McGraw_Hill, 1997
Incropera, F.P. and DeWitt, D.P.,”Basics of Heat and Mass Transfer”(in Turkish), Literatür Publ. Co.,2001.
Bennett, C.O. and Myers,J.E.,”Momentum, Heat and Mass Transfer”, McGraw_Hill,1983
